evidence_nonclaim: This registry defines testable goals and gates; it contains no new physical, provider, economic, or spiritual-communication result.

shared_contract.well_typed: complete AND dimensionally_consistent AND observable AND falsifiable AND provenance_bound
shared_contract.evidence_rule: A composed claim cannot have stronger evidence than its weakest required dependency.
shared_contract.fic_emp_firewall: fictional SCM propositions do not cast to empirical claims; empirical promotion requires operationalization, blind/null controls, ordinary-cause controls, source-dependent information recovery, and independent replication.

goals.objective: Minimize total cost per accepted workload output subject to output_quality >= q_min and latency <= L_max.
goals.acceptance_contract: Equal-workload baseline and source-bound output contract
goals.falsifier: No workload-class advantage without matched output, stronger classical baseline, and full cost ledger
goals.evidence_promotion_rule: Promotion requires lane-specific gate evidence, immutable source/provenance hashes, reproducible tests, and independent evidence where the claim requires it.
goals.unknowns: Represent unmeasured or unavailable quantities as null; never infer zero or success.
